description: Cost of each plan at a team size (or companies/orders, per the product's axis) on monthly or annual billing: monthly equivalent, amount billed per period, commitment, minimums, add-ons and usage. Only for products with price rules; says so otherwise. Never guesses between published price steps: returns a range.

addons.description: Add-on ids from the product's price rules to include in the cost.
addons.title: Addons

include_personal.description: true to also price plans meant for one person (personal or solo plans); false by default.
include_personal.title: Include Personal

plan_id.description: Plan id from the plans field of get_product to price only that plan; leave empty for every plan.
plan_id.title: Plan Id

product_id.description: The product's id, from the id field of a search_products result (e.g. 'toggl'). Only products with price rules (has_cost_rules) can be priced.
product_id.title: Product Id

units.description: Team size, or the product's own unit (companies, orders) as named in its price rules; a whole number of 1 or more.
units.title: Units

usage.description: Metered usage per month as {usage_id: quantity}, with ids from the product's price rules, e.g. {'sms': 500}.
usage.title: Usage

name: estimate_cost
